request: 디자인은 좋지만 로봇처럼 보여 강화슈트 느낌으로 3가지 디벨롭

variants.title: 01 · 작업용 장갑 슈트
variants.detail: Variant 01 FIELD WEAR: closest continuity to original A but worn like practical armored workwear. Primary helmet has original cream wedge brow and amber visor LIFTED above eyes, visibly real adult face and chin below, fabric collar. Main chest is compact cream segmented ribcage breastplate over dark green fabric work suit, not a huge box. Small angular cream shoulder caps sit flush with normal deltoids; matte sage sleeves and trousers with clear dark cloth elbow/knee gussets. Slim detachable forearm assist bracers fit real glove hands. Human waist has visible utility belt and flexible graphite abdominal fabric, cream thigh-front plates cover only outside surfaces, sage greaves taper close to calf, normal reinforced ankle work boots with small cream toe guards. Short low profile flat back battery and thin external hip-to-knee assist strips. Silhouette reads a worker in protective powered clothing, not robotic limbs. Main hero softly bent elbow rests near belt and lowered sword in other hand. Small helmet closed detail shows same orange window, no face screen. Bottom pose a human deep squat and torso-twisting sword cut. Sheet title exact "01 · 작업용 장갑 슈트".
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished landscape 3:2 HEX BLADE PLAYER POWERED SUIT concept sheet, ONE design per sheet.
Input image 1: approved A field-rebuild sheet, reference for cream and muted sage armor, charcoal/indigo joints, amber orange visor, small mint power lights, red straight sword, bold dark outlines and large clean cel-painted planes. Reinterpret its design significantly to answer the user's criticism: the previous concepts look like autonomous robots, now make an adult HUMAN WEARING A POWERED SUIT immediately evident in the MAIN hero illustration, not merely in a small cutaway.
Core correction: fit armor onto a continuous recognizable human body, around 6.5 to 7 heads tall with slightly stylized strong hands/boots. Human trapezius/shoulder slope, narrow flexible neck, anatomical ribcage and waist, recognizable pelvis, ordinary human upper arms/thighs and natural knees/ankles. Helmet fits closely around a real head and has recognizable chin/neck space. Face within helmet must be visible in the main hero, subtle believable human face, no robot eye/mouth screen. Actual human shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles coincide with suit pivots. Gloved hands sized for real five human fingers with normal grip, toes/heels inside wearable boots rather than huge robot wedge feet. Exposed dark FABRIC under-suit clearly visible at neck, armpits, flexible abdomen, groin, inner elbows and backs of knees; use readable cloth folds/seams/rib-knit rather than robot round sockets. Armor is worn OUTSIDE the fabric with belts, cuffs, attachment tabs, discrete thin assist links. Human head occupies the helmet; do not show mini-pilot in chest.
Keep angular industrial protection and appealing original game identity. Do not turn into a generic superhero costume, tactical rifle soldier, metallic photoreal Iron Man or giant Gundam. Reduce armor thickness, floating shoulder blocks, machine torso volume, huge hands/feet, twin exhaust backpack. No tall antennas, robot piston neck, independent robot limbs, robot skirt, cockpit, chest seat, tiny person in pelvis, empty shell action figure.
Composition: warm off-white paper background, mint subtle section accents. Large full-body 3/4 main hero ~left 42% showing person in suit, natural weight shift and lowered red sword. Smaller coherent full-body FRONT and BACK views central top, compact clean side wearable anatomy overlay on right (one adult continuous body through helmet, torso, limbs and boots), and 2 lower-right movement details showing how flexible cloth bends and armor clears a crouch/torso turn. One small helmet-open detail makes wearer explicit. All boots fully inside canvas. Simple readable labels, not dense tiny technical gibberish. No giant marketing header, no dimension arrows or unverified measurements. Follow same proportions and mechanism in every view.
Rendering: confident thick dark navy outlines, clear bevel planes, two or three cel-shaded values, clean cream/sage industrial masses, restrained lavender gray shadows, few broad material accents. No rust/scratches/greeble overload, no glossy photographic metal.

variants.title: 02 · 밀착 기동 슈트
variants.detail: Variant 02 FLEX MOBILITY: distinctive lean articulated powered suit with strongly visible uninterrupted charcoal textile body core. Half-shell cream armored jacket covers upper chest/back and small clavicle shoulder pads; fitted sage limb panels only at OUTER arms and shins with black fabric clearly visible across inner limbs and side abdomen. Helmet compact cream brow, continuous translucent AMBER visor with real eyes/nose faintly visible behind glass and a normal graphite chin cup, no glowing autonomous robot face. Short flexible collar. Narrow articulated external spine assist sits close down middle back, tiny rectangular mint battery at lower back. Elbow and knee assists are thin side bands, not giant cylinders. Human-sized tactical powered gloves have a single modest back-of-hand plate and actual fingers, running/work boots have ankle articulation and normal human soles, no high heels. No huge V torso or hourglass fetish anatomy. Strong but natural adult athletic fit, practical clothed proportions. One red straight sword, lowered with an anatomically human grip. Action inset a low running lunge showing stretched fabric inner thigh/ankles and a twisting cut with shoulder plate clearance. Helmet-open inset shows adult head inside. Sheet title exact "02 · 밀착 기동 슈트".

variants.title: 03 · 외부 프레임 슈트
variants.detail: Variant 03 EXTERNAL ASSIST: slightly more robust industrial assisted harness, visually a recognizable adult person in sage-and-charcoal workwear surrounded by a LIGHT cream external load-bearing exoframe, distinct from designs 1 and 2. Main head wears close-fitting cream protective helmet with amber short brow visor flipped UP, entire human face/chin visible; no oversized machine head. Cream chest harness forms TWO thin angular side rails around fabric chest, one small sage sternum plate plus fabric and broad waist load belt, not solid robot torso. Modest cream forearm cuffs and external shoulder-yoke sit outside human arms with cloth visible; two slim assist rails along outer hips/thighs ending at knee hinge placed beside actual knee. Legs have sage fabric pants, discrete angular knee/shin protection and very human-looking sturdy boots within small cream heel/toe support brackets; wearer feet clearly enter boots. Back has compact flat power pack between shoulder blades with visible padded shoulder straps, no huge twin engine pods. A single red sword, anatomy remains same size as the wearer, no super-sized limbs. A small rear donning inset shows wearer sliding arms through shoulder straps while frame is open at back, no seated cockpit. Action detail braced two-handed sword stance and crouch show load assist rails following human joints. Helmet/cloth folds and straps make the wearer evident at first glance. Sheet title exact "03 · 외부 프레임 슈트".
